thread:
maya (PM): ok — we need to settle scope for the next tool/call iteration. enterprise customers keep asking for nested schemas + streaming results + partial success semantics. want a short list of must-haves for an MVP and what can be deferred.

alex (Eng-Platform): +1. propose we split into two surfaces: a compact "lite" invoke for simple name/args, and a full invoke for rich schemas/streaming. keeps rollout safer.

sam (Eng): agree. lite = instant value for PLG. constraints: 256KB total payload, 1 nested level max for args. full = no artificial nesting limit but slower path.

kevin (Eng-ML): runtime concerns: streaming tool results means keeping KV cache pinned longer and extra socket churn. perf cost estimate: ~10-20% tail latency increase on T4 unless we batch differently. also need telemetry hooks to correlate model->tool calls.

maya (PM): good. can we add concrete launch criteria? e.g., 3 GA customers signed for full invoke OR 1000 active accounts using lite for 30d, + telemetry proving error-rate <1% for tool calls.

alex (Eng-Platform): launch checklist draft:
- API: v1-lite (backcompat design) + v2-full (new header X-RI-Invoke-Version: full)
- Schema: allow opt-in schema registry ref (schema_id) for heavy customers; fallback to inline schema for others
- Telemetry: include call_id, tool_id, schema_id, bytes_in/out, partial_success flag
- RBAC: token scope "invoke:tools" & optional "invoke:tools:execute-as-service"
- Limits: default payload 256KB, tenant override via dedicated config for Dedicated/Private
- Fallback policy: if full path fails, downgrade to lite with a 429->400 conversion rule

maya (PM): +1. customers also asked for partial-results streaming (e.g., 2/3 tools responded). do we add an explicit "partial" envelope?

sam (Eng): recommend explicit envelope so clients can handle partial success deterministically. example:
```json
{
  "tool_call": {"name": "fetch_customer","args": {...}},
  "result": {
    "status": "partial",
    "completed": ["fetch_customer"],
    "failed": [{"name":"enrich","error":"timeout"}],
    "results_by_tool": {"fetch_customer": {"ok": {...}}}
  }
}
```

kevin (Eng-ML): also capture a per-tool latency histogram and "confidence" tag if the tool returns quality metrics. helps Optimize recommendations.

alex (Eng-Platform): rollout plan idea:
- Phase 0: internal canary (eng+se) with X-RI-Invoke-Version header, no public docs
- Phase 1: opt-in beta for tenants (lite + full behind feature flag)
- Phase 2: public docs for lite, beta for full (telemetry gates)
- Phase 3: GA when telemetry gates met and 3 enterprise signoffs

maya (PM): prioritization: must-haves for next sprint -> v1-lite + envelope for partial success + telemetry keys. deferrables -> schema registry UI, per-tenant payload overrides (Dedicated/Private only).

alex (Eng-Platform): I'll open a short RFC with examples + client migration notes. tagging @kevin for perf numbers and @sam for limits enforcement details.

release-bot: deploy queued for branch/feature/tool-invoke-lite (CI 42) :rocket:

maya (PM): perfect. I'll send this as minutes to stakeholders and include the launch criteria. thanks all :tada:
